Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Sales Enablement Specialist position at Atlas Copco. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am excited about the opportunity to support the continuous improvement of digital sales tools and processes.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites, which has honed my analytical and structured approach to digital projects. I am comfortable working with data and dashboards, and I have experience with tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. My project mirook.com involved implementing structured data and optimizing for AI-driven search, demonstrating my interest in emerging technologies.

I am particularly drawn to Atlas Copco's culture of innovation and continuous improvement. I am eager to contribute to user adoption, change management, and the localization of applications, ensuring a seamless customer journey across digital platforms.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available for a hybrid work arrangement. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills align with your team's goals.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
